# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python

- At least 2 years of work experience

- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

- AWS

- MLflow

- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).

- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python

- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python

- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are

- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)

- At least 2 years of work experience

- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).

- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)

- At least 2 years of work experience

- AWS

- MLflow

- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

- Python

- AWS

- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).

- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

- AWS

- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL

- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

- AWS

- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are

- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.
